name: Ko-fi
author: WolfyMaster LLC
description: Receives Ko-fi webhooks and fires triggers when someone tips, starts or renews a membership, buys from your shop, or orders a commission.

settings.label: Ko-fi verification token
settings.description: Copy this from Ko-fi's webhook settings, under Advanced. Requests without it are refused.

triggers.name: Ko-fi webhook
triggers.description: Paste this URL into Ko-fi's webhook settings. Every request is checked against your verification token before anything fires.

triggers.name: Ko-fi donation
triggers.description: Fires when someone sends a one-off tip on Ko-fi.

fields.description: Ko-fi's id for this payment. A retried delivery carries the same id.

The supporter's message. Empty when they left none or asked to stay private.
False when the supporter asked that their name and message stay off stream.
In the currency's main unit: 3 is 3.00.
The amount with two decimals and no currency symbol.
ISO 4217 code.
Link to the payment on Ko-fi.

triggers.name: Ko-fi membership payment
